$comment: Backend contract for Eyadty derived from the Flutter code at commit 55d76d9. Endpoint names are ASSUMED by the client team and may be renamed by the backend developer; keep field names or provide a mapping. All ids are server UUID strings; timestamps ISO-8601 UTC; money in EGP as integer piasters OR decimal (confirm). Tenant = account; every record is scoped by accountId and branchId.

conventions.auth: Bearer JWT access token + refresh token (admin/auth/login, admin/auth/refresh). Roles and per-permission matrix (StaffPermission enum) enforced server side.
conventions.idempotency: Mutations accept header Idempotency-Key = client operationId. Replays must return the original result.
conventions.revision: Every mutable entity has integer revision; update sends baseRevision; mismatch returns 409 with serverVersion.
conventions.softDelete: Deletes are tombstones (isDeleted + revision bump) so pull can propagate them.
conventions.immutability: Finalized visits, payments, settlements and ledger entries are append-only: corrections via addendum or reversal entry, never overwrite.

pull.request: entityType + opaque cursor (never a wall clock)

specialtyRecords.summary: add typed record (pediatrics growth/vaccines, ob-gyn, dental, derm/cosmetic)

sync.summary: batch push of outbox operations; idempotent by operationId

notes: Field lists were extracted mechanically from Dart model classes; the backend developer must confirm nullability, indexes and constraints.
Field names marked dartType are not mapped yet.
Booking.bookingType=emergency means walk-in: no slot required, counted as waiting until slot end.
Friday is a clinic holiday in demo data; holidays come from Settings.specialHolidays and doctor schedules.

money.note: 1 EGP = 100 piastres. Cashier shifts, payments, refunds, movements, HR rules, settlements, and analytics KPIs use integer piastres.

timezone.note: All timestamps are persisted in UTC. Day boundaries, slot availability, and Friday weekly holiday checks are evaluated in Africa/Cairo.
